an7.52:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Campāyaṃ viharati Gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
an7.52:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā Campeyyakā upāsakā yenāyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te Campeyyakā upāsakā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avocuṃ
an7.52:1.4: sādhu mayaṃ bhante labheyyāma Bhagavato sammukhā dhammikathaṃ savanāyā' ti.
an7.52:1.6: app eva nāma labheyyātha Bhagavato sammukhā dhammikathaṃ savanāyā' ti.
an7.52:1.7: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho te Campeyyakā upāsakā āyasmato Sāriputtassa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
an7.52:2.1: Atha kho te Campeyyakā upāsakā tadahu 'posathe yenāyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
an7.52:2.2: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto tehi Campeyyakehi upāsakehi saddhiṃ yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:-- 2.
an7.52:3.1: Siyā nu kho bhante idh' ekaccassa tādisaṃ yeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ na mahapphalaṃ na mahānisaṃsaṃ,
an7.52:3.2: siyā pana bhante idh' ekaccassa tādisaṃ yeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ mahānisaṃsan ti?
an7.52:3.3: Siyā Sāriputta idh' ekaccassa tādisaṃ yeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ na mahānisaṃsaṃ,
an7.52:3.4: siyā pana Sāriputta idh' ekaccassa tādisaṃ yeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ mahānisaṃsan ti. 3.
an7.52:3.5: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo, yena-m- idh' ekaccassa tādisaṃ yeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti na mahānisaṃsaṃ;
an7.52:3.6: ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo, yena-m-idh' ekaccassa tādisaṃ yeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsan ti?
an7.52:4.1: Idha Sāriputta ekacco sāpekho dānaṃ deti, paṭibaddhacitto dānaṃ deti, sannidhipekho dānaṃ deti, ‘imaṃ pecca paribhuñjissāmī' ti dānaṃ deti.
an7.52:4.2: So taṃ dānaṃ deti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ.
an7.52:4.3: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Sāriputta: dadeyya idh' ekacco evarūpaṃ dānan ti?
an7.52:5.1: Tatra Sāriputta yvāyaṃ sāpekho dānaṃ deti, paṭibaddhacitto dānaṃ deti, sannidhipekho dānaṃ deti, ‘imaṃ pecca paribhuñjissāmī' ti dānaṃ deti:
an7.52:5.2: so taṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an7.52:5.3: So taṃ kammaṃ khepetvā taṃ iddhiṃ taṃ yasaṃ taṃ adhipateyyaṃ āgāmī hoti āgantā itthattaṃ. 4.
an7.52:6.1: Idha pana Sāriputta ekacco na h' eva kho sāpekho dānaṃ deti, na paṭibaddhacitto dānaṃ deti, na sannidhipekho dānaṃ deti, na ‘imaṃ pecca paribhuñjissāmī' ti dānaṃ deti,
an7.52:6.2: api ca kho ‘sāhu dānan' ti dānaṃ deti . . . pe . . .
an7.52:7.1: na pi ‘sāhu dānan' ti dānaṃ deti,
an7.52:7.2: api ca kho ‘dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ pitupitāmahehi, na arahāmi porāṇaṃ kulavaṃsaṃ hāpetun' ti dānaṃ deti . . .
an7.52:8.1: na pi ‘dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ pitupitāmahehi, na arahāmi porāṇaṃ kulavaṃsaṃ hāpetun' ti dānaṃ deti,
an7.52:8.2: api ca kho ‘ahaṃ pacāmi, ime na pacanti, na arahāmi pacanto apacantānaṃ dānaṃ adātun' ti dānaṃ deti . . .
an7.52:9.1: na pi ‘ahaṃ pacāmi, ime na pacanti, na arahāmi pacanto apacantānaṃ dānaṃ adātun' ti dānaṃ deti,
an7.52:9.2: api ca kho ‘yathā tesaṃ pubbakānaṃ isīnaṃ tāni mahāyaññāni ahesuṃ, seyyathīdaṃ
an7.52:9.3: Aṭṭhakassa Vāmakassa Vāmadevassa Vessāmittassa Yamataggino Aṅgīrasassa Bhāradvājassa Vāseṭṭhassa Kassapassa Bhaguno, evaṃ me ayaṃ dānasaṃvibhāgo bhavissatī' ti dānaṃ deti . . .
an7.52:10.1: na pi ‘yathā tesaṃ pubbakānaṃ isīnaṃ tāni mahāyaññāni ahesuṃ, seyyathīdaṃ
an7.52:10.2: Aṭṭhakassa Vāmakassa Vāmadevassa Vessāmittassa Yamataggino Aṅgīrasassa Bhāradvājassa Vāseṭṭhassa Kassapassa Bhaguno, evaṃ me ayaṃ dānasaṃvibhāgo bhavissatī' ti dānaṃ deti,
an7.52:10.3: api ca kho ‘imaṃ me dānaṃ dadato cittaṃ pasīdati, attamanatāsomanassaṃ upajāyatī' ti dānaṃ deti . . .
an7.52:11.1: na pi ‘imaṃ me dānaṃ dadato cittaṃ pasīdati, attamanatāsomanassaṃ upajāyatī' ti dānaṃ deti,
an7.52:11.2: api ca kho cittālaṃkāraṃ cittaparikkhāratthaṃ dānaṃ deti.
an7.52:11.3: So taṃ dānaṃ deti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ.
an7.52:11.4: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Sāriputta: dadeyya idh' ekacco evarūpaṃ dānan ti?
an7.52:12.1: Tatra Sāriputta yvāyaṃ na h' eva kho sāpekho dānaṃ deti,
an7.52:12.4: na ‘imaṃ pecca paribhuñjissāmī' ti dānaṃ deti,
an7.52:12.5: na pi ‘sāhu dānan' ti dānaṃ deti,
an7.52:12.6: na pi dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ pitupitāmahehi, na arahāmi porāṇaṃ kulavaṃsaṃ hāpetun' ti dānaṃ deti,
an7.52:12.7: na pi ‘ahaṃ pacāmi, ime na pacanti, na arahāmi pacanto apacantānaṃ dānaṃ adātun' ti dānaṃ deti,
an7.52:12.8: na pi ‘yathā tesaṃ pubbakānaṃ isīnaṃ tāni mahāyaññāni ahesuṃ, seyyathīdaṃ
an7.52:12.9: Aṭṭhakassa Vāmakassa Vāmadevassa Vessāmittassa Yamataggino Aṅgīrasassa Bhāradvājassa Vāseṭṭhassa Kassapassa Bhaguno, evaṃ me ayaṃ dānasaṃvibhāgo bhavissatī' ti dānaṃ deti,
an7.52:12.10: na pi ‘imaṃ me dānaṃ dadato cittaṃ pasīdati, attamanatāsomanassaṃ upajāyatī' ti dānaṃ deti,
an7.52:12.11: api ca kho cittālaṃkāraṃ cittaparikkhāratthaṃ dānaṃ deti:
an7.52:12.12: so taṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an7.52:12.13: So taṃ kammaṃ khepetvā taṃ iddhiṃ taṃ yasaṃ taṃ adhipateyyaṃ, anāgāmī hoti anāgantā itthattaṃ.
an7.52:13.1: Ayaṃ kho Sāriputta hetu ayaṃ paccayo, yena-m-idh' ekaccassa tādisaṃ yeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ na mahapphalaṃ hoti na mahānisaṃsaṃ,
an7.52:13.2: ayaṃ pana Sāriputta hetu ayaṃ paccayo, yena-m-idh' ekaccassa tādisaṃ yeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsaṃ.
